NightGraphics — original project artwork, October 11, 2026

Author/source: original vector artwork and geometric lettering created with Codex
for AlKoda's Jewelry-store-vr-demo. Reproducible source: Tools/make_night_graphics.cjs.
No downloaded images, logos, typefaces, font binaries or forensic reference prints.
SVG masters and rasterized PNGs are project-generated assets; no third-party
attribution or redistribution restrictions apply to this artwork.

Aurel & Finch is a fictional shop label created for this demo, not a claim of
affiliation with a real retailer. It can be renamed in the generator.
ShoeTrace_Generic is an illustrative outsole pattern, not a real shoe identification
reference. Scuff and dust smear have no assigned evidential or biological meaning.
No police-service crest, country identifier or UV-fluorescence meaning is included.
